section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Family Fat Talk Questionnaire (FFTQ-F), a 16-item, 2-factor instrument measuring self-critical, body-related conversations within the family context. The questionnaire includes a Family subscale (8 items examining fat talk exhibited by family members) and a Self subscale (8 items reflecting the respondent's own disparaging comments about their body when with family). Items are rated on a 5-point Likert scale, and the instrument has demonstrated excellent internal consistency and convergent validity with peer fat talk, body dissatisfaction, and social physique anxiety. The present analysis focused only on the Family subscale, which showed excellent internal consistency (α = 0.92).
